record.official_rationale: Sierra Leone officials cited uncertain nationality and absence of prior repatriation notification; Guinea alleged security offences among those expelled. Security screening is context, not a separate demonstrated closure motive.
record.context: Guinea transported alleged Sierra Leonean nationals to border on10December2024. Sierra Leone refused entry pending nationality and protocol checks; police account reports temporaryclosure during11December standoff.
record.uncertainty: One police-notice lineage supports closure. AfricaGuinee introduction places tensions onTuesday while its quotednotice dates closureWednesday11December; prefer explicit quotednotice but preserve discrepancy. Reopened by13December report, exactdate/hour unknown. Guinea disputes lack-of-notification account, asserting administrative delay. Do not interpret publicationdate as reopeningdate or presume all categories barred.
